senses.gloss: f. (מָשַׁח II) band, cord, esp. flax rope for surveying.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Eiruvin 6:13">Tosef. Erub. VI</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Eiruvin 5:13">V</cite>), 13.
<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 21:3">Kel. XXI, 3</cite> <he>בחוט ובמ׳</he> the string or the rope (of the saw).

<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 5:2">Tosef. Sabb. V</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 6:2">VI</cite>), 2 <he>כרכן במ׳</he> (ed. Zuck. <he>במשיחא</he>) tied a cord around them; <cite ref="Shabbat 50a">Sabb. 50ᵃ</cite>.

<cite ref="Tosefta Chullin 3:7">Tosef. Ḥull. III</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Chullin 4:22">IV</cite>), 22 <he>כל הנותן ע״ג מ׳ החולק וכ׳</he> when you place a fowl on a rope, that fowl which divides its claws &c., is unclean; <cite ref="Chullin 65a:3">Ḥull. 65ᵃ</cite> <he>מותחין לו חוט של מ׳</he> you stretch a cord for it in a line; a. fr.—Pl. <cite ref="M02875"><he>מְשִׁיחוֹת</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Kilayim 9:9">Kil. IX, 9</cite> <he>מ׳ של ארגמן</he> purple-colored ribbons, v. <cite ref="M01590"><he>מָלַל</he></cite> I end; Y. ib. 32ᵈ.
<cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Metsia 4:7">Tosef. Kel. B. Mets. IV, 7</cite>.
